name: Verizon
summary: One of the three national networks. Plans are postpaid and billed monthly.
autopayTerms: Verizon takes up to $10 off each line every month when you use Auto Pay and paper-free billing paid from a bank account or Verizon Visa Card. Debit and other credit cards don't qualify, except debit cards enrolled before Feb 14, 2024.

fees.oneTimeNote: Verizon's plan pages don't list an activation fee.
